sections.section: RULE - Punjab Professions and Trade Tax Rules 1977
sections.description:
PUNJAB PROFESSIONS AND TRADE
PUNJAB PROFESSIONS AND TRADE
TAX RULES, 1977
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
11th April, 2018]
No. SO.TAX(E&T) 3-15/2001 (PLGA), dated
30.12.2016.---In exercise of
powers conferred under section 8 of the Punjab Finance Act, 1977 (XV of 1977),
Governor of the Punjab is pleased to direct that in the Punjab Professions and
Trade Tax Rules, 1977, the following amendment shall be made:
In the said rules:
(1) in rule
2:
(i) for
clause (b), the following shall be substituted:
"(b) "Director, Excise and Taxation"
means an officer appointed by the Government to discharge the functions and
perform the duties of the Director, Excise and Taxation in specified
area;";
(ii) for
clause (c), the following shall be substituted:
"(c)" "District Excise and Taxation
officer" means an officer appointed by the Government to discharge the
functions and perform the duties as such in any specified area and includes a
Senior Excise and Taxation Officer:"; and
(iii) in
clause (f), for the expression "District Officer/Excise and Taxation
Officer or Deputy District Officer/Excise and Taxation Officer", the words
"District Excise and Taxation Officer" shall be substituted;
(2) in rules
3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11, for the expression "District
Officer/Excise and Taxation Officer or Deputy District Officer/Excise and
Taxation Officer as the case may be", wherever occurs, the words
"District Excise and Taxation Officer" shall be substituted; and
(3) in rules
4 and 5, for the expression "District Officer/Director, Excise and
Taxation", wherever occurs, the words "Director, Excise and
Taxation" shall be substituted.
